tab-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：斯卡伯勒机场的跑道紧邻多巴哥海岸，航站楼与机坪在跑道一侧，周围是海滩与绿丘。
tab-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Scarborough's runway lies beside the Tobago coast, with the terminal and apron alongside it and beach and green hills around.

tab-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 波浪形屋顶的现代化航站楼通体玻璃幕墙，红色字母牌写着机场全名，空荡的水泥机坪上只画着标线。
tab-chatgpt-01.webp.en: A modern terminal with a rippling roof and glass walls is lettered in red with the airport's full name above an empty concrete apron.

tab-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 航拍：笔直的跑道紧挨着海岸线，蓝绿色的海水拍打着沙滩，红顶度假屋与市镇在旁侧铺展。
tab-chatgpt-02.webp.en: The straight runway hugs the shoreline, turquoise water breaking on the beach while red-roofed resorts and a town spread alongside.

tab-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 机场外的车道上立着蓝色指示牌，几顶白色帐篷沿着廊柱排开，低垂的阴云压住屋顶。
tab-chatgpt-03.webp.en: Blue signs stand beside the access lane, white tents line the columns of the terminal front, and low grey cloud hangs over the roofs.

tab-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 候机厅里成排的深蓝座椅面向落地窗，木质天花板泛着暖光，窗外是淡淡的午后亮色。
tab-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Rows of deep blue seats face the floor-to-ceiling windows of the departure lounge, where the timber ceiling glows warm in the afternoon light.

tab-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 一架加勒比航空的客机正滑行经过草地边沿，橙色的跑道灯连成一串，灰蒙蒙的背景里立着成排楼宇。
tab-chatgpt-05.webp.en: A Caribbean Airlines jet taxis past a grassy bank strung with orange lights, with rows of buildings standing in the grey distance.

tab-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 老式值机厅里竖着水泥圆柱，紫色柜台编号排列，红色的隔离带拉出蛇形通道，一对旅客坐在长椅上等。
tab-chatgpt-06.webp.en: Inside an older check-in hall, concrete columns rise above numbered purple desks, red rope barriers form a queue lane and a couple waits on a bench.

tab-chatgpt-07.webp.zh: 入夜后航站楼的灯牌通明，照亮弧形雨棚下的落客车道，一辆轿车停在空地上，红白条纹柱子分立两侧。
tab-chatgpt-07.webp.en: After dark the terminal's glowing sign lights the curved canopy over the drop-off lane, where a car waits beside red-and-white striped columns.
